recognize_zh: 左側為淡粉紅、細胞輪廓模糊但仍隱約可見的凝固性壞死（coagulative necrosis），右側是密集的多形性淋巴樣浸潤並夾雜血管；這種壞死鄰接多形性浸潤的組合常見於多形性 PTLD（polymorphic PTLD）。
features: Pale eosinophilic zone of coagulative necrosis with ghost cell outlines on the left
Dense cellular infiltrate with mixed small and larger nuclei on the right
Sharp but irregular interface between necrosis and viable infiltrate
Scattered small blood vessels and focal hemorrhage in the viable area
Few eosinophilic cellular clumps at the edge of necrosis
Individual cell detail limited at this magnification
describe_en: Low-to-intermediate power H&E section shows a large zone of coagulative necrosis with ghost cell outlines on the left, abutting a dense viable infiltrate on the right composed of cells of varying nuclear size with scattered small vessels and focal hemorrhage. Fine cytologic detail is limited at this magnification. Findings are consistent with polymorphic post-transplant lymphoproliferative disorder with geographic necrosis, which should prompt EBER in situ hybridization and clonality assessment.

ddx.vs: Monomorphic PTLD shows necrosis adjacent to sheets of uniformly large transformed B cells rather than a mixed population of small lymphocytes, plasma cells and immunoblasts.
Infectious necrosis is typically suppurative or granulomatous with neutrophils or histiocytes and demonstrable organisms, not a lymphoplasmacytic infiltrate with EBV-positive cells.

ddx.dx: Extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma or lymphomatoid granulomatosis
ddx.vs: These show angiocentric infiltrates with vessel destruction and CD56+ cytotoxic T/NK cells or EBV-positive large B cells in a T-cell background.
